extension_decision.rationale: The Data domain requires entity-relationship modeling, migration sequencing, and index strategy not expressible in core steps 05-07.

extensions.title: Database Schema
extensions.justification: Core spec steps lack entity-relationship modeling, migration sequencing, and index strategy — three dedicated schema sections are needed to cover the data domain.
extensions.schema_design_guidelines: Reuse vc:core:atoms#kebabId for table IDs. Each table must include a validation_rules section with at least one check constraint. Verify referential integrity across foreign key relationships.

extensions.title: Session Management
extensions.justification: Authentication flows require dedicated session lifecycle, token rotation, and revocation schema sections that exceed core step 05 interface contracts.
extensions.schema_design_guidelines: Reuse vc:core:atoms#kebabId for session IDs. Include test coverage for token expiry edge cases. Verify session invalidation on password change events.
